clips.label: Low
clips.prompt: Only the lower legs of one person wearing beige trousers tucked inside brown high-top sneakers are visible above a trampoline. Gravity pulls the person downward, and contact bounciness affects the rebound after both shoes touch the mat. The camera remains fixed; no hands, arms, or upper body are visible.
